marks.q: “We have made a positive start to FY2023 and our order book remains strong. We have, however, recently seen a weakening in order intake from the semiconductor and electronics sectors, and general market sentiment is becoming more cautious.”
“Overall Group performance was in line with our expectations for the first quarter of the year. …… We have made a positive start to the current year and our order book remains strong.”
“We have a strong order book, and at this stage we expect full year revenue to be in the range of £690m to £730m. Adjusted profit before tax is expected to be in the range of £140m to £165m.”
“We anticipate that revenue for the full year will be between £680m and £700m, and adjusted profit before tax will be between £135m and £150m.”

“Trading conditions remain challenging due to subdued demand, most notably from the semiconductor sector. We continue to see positive investment trends in robotics, defence, low emission transportation and additive manufacturing.”
“Trading conditions remain challenging due to subdued demand, most notably from the semiconductor sector. … We are confident in our strategy to deliver sustainable long-term growth.”

“We expect an improvement in our trading performance in the second half of the financial year as market conditions improve…… At this stage we expect full year revenue ……(£675m–£715m). Adjusted profit before tax ……(£122m–£147m).”

“We expect the recent improvement in our trading performance to strengthen in the remainder of the financial year, as market conditions improve…… We now expect revenue ……(£680m–£700m) and adjusted profit before tax ……(£122m–£135m).”

“We expect these efforts, together with higher sales volumes, to drive our operating profit margin towards our target, although inflationary pressures, especially people costs, will affect the rate of improvement in the near term.”

“We continue to pursue a range of growth opportunities and anticipate solid overall revenue growth this year in line with the Board's expectations. … we remain cautious about demand from this market [semiconductor] in the remainder of FY2025.”
“Order intake recently improved, steady revenue growth expected to continue in H2. FY2025 revenue: £695m to £735m; adjusted profit before tax: £105m to £135m.”

“We enter the final quarter of the year with good momentum, but we are mindful of the volatile economic backdrop…… We now expect revenue ……(£700m–£720m) and adjusted profit before tax ……(£109m–£127m).”
“Confidence in further progress towards margin improvement objective, supported by £20m annualised payroll reduction to take effect in FY26 H1.”
“There has been a steady start to FY2026, in line with our expectations. … at this stage we are expecting to achieve further steady revenue growth in the year ahead.”
“We enter H2 with momentum and we expect to achieve strong revenue and profit growth in the remainder of the year. Revenue: £740m to £780m; Adjusted profit before tax: £132m to £157m.”
“Upgrade to FY2026 guidance. … We now expect to deliver FY2026 full-year performance in the following ranges: Revenue: £775m to £805m; Adjusted profit before tax: £145m to £165m.”

“We expect positive market conditions to continue for the remainder of FY2026…… Our expectations for FY2026 full-year performance remain in line with recently upgraded guidance: Revenue ……(£775m–£805m); Adjusted profit before tax ……(£145m–£165m).”

“Record Q4 revenue; FY2026 profit ahead of expectations. We saw accelerating growth throughout the year, culminating in record quarterly revenue in Q4 of approximately £243m, 27% above the prior year.”

“FY2027 has started strongly as we continue to benefit from the current upturn in demand for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. We expect further strong progress on revenue, profit and operating margin in the year ahead.”

“We have seen a strong start to FY2027, continuing and broadening the momentum that we established throughout the prior year…… We continue to expect strong progress on revenue and operating margin for FY2027 as a whole.”
